scope: GFX100RF MakerNote rendering intent to editable Phocus sidecar settings
raw_payload_policy: immutable linear RAW; rendering intent is written only to the sibling .3FR.phos file

authoritative_sources.title: FUJIFILM GFX100RF Owner's Manual - Image Quality Setting
supports: D Range Priority adjusts dynamic range and tone automatically
Highlight and shadow tone controls range from -2 to +4
Grain roughness supports off, weak and strong; size supports small and large

authoritative_sources.title: Hasselblad Phocus User Manual
supports: Exposure compensation, highlight recovery and shadow fill are distinct editable adjustments
Saturation is a global adjustment while Vibrancy protects already-saturated regions
Clarity and Detail are separate controls
Film grain amount, granularity, roughness and colour are independently editable

authoritative_sources.title: Installed Phocus 3.8.8 standard presets and clean RAF3FR sidecar
supports: Standard sharpening uses USM amount 100, radius 10 and noise limit 0
Portrait and Nature presets anchor conservative and stronger USM amounts at 90 and 180
Saturation, Contrast and Clarity are zero-centered global integer fields
NoiseFilterBias and CNFilter are separate from USM and remain disabled in RAF3FR output

sample_inventory.exposure_bias_boundary: The 0.23 EV branches also occur at the same DR and ISO, and sometimes the same shutter and aperture. They are read per file and are not inferred from ISO.

controlled_pairs.purpose: highlight tone -1 versus +1 with otherwise matching rendering controls
DR200 versus DR100 with matching exposure and rendering controls
grain off, weak/small and strong/small with matching scene and exposure
controlled_pairs.observation: flat-region high-pass standard deviation is approximately 0.01547, 0.01719 and 0.02163; after subtracting the off baseline variance, strong added amplitude is approximately twice weak

dynamic_range.claim: bounded monotonic approximation, strengthened from 0/10/20 to 0/15/30 by user visual preference: the official GFX100RF manual defines ordinary DR as highlight-detail protection, while D Range Priority explicitly addresses both highlights and shadows; Phocus does not publish a stop calibration for either slider

tone_curve.claim: bounded monotonic approximation, increased slightly from the controlled-pair baseline by user visual preference; not a Fujifilm tone-engine reproduction

grain.claim: amount ratio is sample-supported; absolute Phocus amount, granularity and roughness are approximations

color.claim: semantic monotonic approximation; no claim of reproducing a film simulation or Color Chrome

contrast.claim: semantic monotonic approximation to the zero-centered Phocus global Contrast field

clarity.mapping: Phocus Clarity = clamp(Fuji Clarity step * 10, -50, 50); Detail = 0
clarity.claim: semantic monotonic approximation that does not infer unsupported fine-detail intent

sharpness.mapping: USM amount = clamp(100 + Fuji Sharpness step * 25, 0, 200); radius 10; noise limit 0
sharpness.claim: conservative approximation anchored to installed Standard, Portrait and Nature presets; CNFilter and NoiseFilterBias remain disabled

monochrome.mapping: recognized monochrome and ACROS modes enable Phocus neutral grayscale weights [100,21,72,7]; Sepia is record-only
monochrome.claim: preserves black-and-white intent only; Fuji filter and warm/cool/magenta/green rendering remain metadata because no calibrated Phocus equivalent exists

record_only.reason: No stable direct Phocus equivalent is available. NoiseFilterBias and CNFilter are specifically excluded because they reintroduce the forced smoothing path that RAF3FR keeps disabled.
